schemes.title: 2025 MediSave Bonus
schemes.description: Boosts healthcare savings of seniors born in 1950-1973 with lower MediSave balances.

schemes.title: 2025 Public Transport Voucher (PTV) Exercise
schemes.description: Provides lower-income households with PTVs to cope with the fare adjustment from 27 December 2025.

schemes.title: ABSD Concession for Single Singapore Citizen Seniors
schemes.description: Provides single Singapore Citizen seniors (aged 55 and above) a refund for the Additional Buyer's Stamp Duty (ABSD) on their second residential property purchase.

schemes.title: Active Ageing Centres (AAC)
schemes.description: A centre for seniors to build strong social connections, take part in recreational activities, access community health services, and contribute to the community.

schemes.title: ActiveSG Membership
schemes.description: A national movement for individuals, families and communities to experience and share the joy of living better through sports.

schemes.title: Addiction Support Programme for Inclusion, Recovery, and Empowerment (ASPIRE)
schemes.description: For individuals aged 10 and above who have a present or past addiction issue (including gaming, compulsive gambling, shoplifting, drugs, alcohol, sex and porn use) or are currently impacted by the addiction of a loved one.

schemes.title: Additional Premium Support for MediShield Life and CareShield Life
schemes.description: Provides financial support for Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents who are unable to afford their MediShield Life and/or CareShield Life premiums (where applicable) even after Government subsidies and MediSave use and have limited family support.

schemes.title: Adoption Leave for Mothers (AL)
schemes.description: Provides up to 12 weeks of leave for eligible adoptive mothers to care for their adopted child.

schemes.title: Advance Care Planning (ACP)
schemes.description: Helps communicate your values and how they shape your healthcare preferences to your loved ones and healthcare team.

schemes.title: Application for Deceased's Unnominated CPF Monies
schemes.description: Distribution of the un-nominated Central Provident Fund (CPF) monies of the Deceased Member in accordance with the relevant written law.

schemes.title: Assistance Scheme for Second Timers (Divorced/ Widowed Parents) (ASSIST)
schemes.description: Allocates up to 5% of flats for eligible divorced or widowed parents applying for 2-room Flexi and 3-room BTO flats.

schemes.title: Assisted Deputyship Application Programme (ADAP)
schemes.description: ADAP supports caregivers of children without mental capacity to apply to be court-appointed deputies, through the simplified deputyship process. As a deputy, the caregiver can make legal decisions for the child when he/she turns 21.

schemes.title: Assistive Technology Fund (ATF)
schemes.description: Provides subsidies for persons with disabilities (PWDs) to purchase assistive technology devices to enable independent living. The devices should aid early intervention, education, training, employment, therapy, rehabilitation and/or independence in daily living for PWDs.

schemes.title: Assurance Package (AP) Cash
schemes.description: $700 to $2,250 cash payouts over 5 years from 2022 to 2026 for adult Singapore Citizens aged 21 and above, residing in Singapore, based on Assessable Income and number of properties owned.

schemes.title: Assurance Package (AP) MediSave
schemes.description: MediSave top-up of $150 each year from 2023 to 2025, for Singapore Citizens aged 20 and below, or 55 and above, residing in Singapore.

schemes.title: Assurance Package (AP) Seniors' Bonus
schemes.description: $600 to $900 cash payouts over 3 years from 2023 to 2025 for eligible Singapore Citizens aged 55 and above.

schemes.title: Babes Pregnancy Crisis Support
schemes.description: For individuals aged 21 and below needing support with their pregnancy, so that they are aware of their options and are able to make an informed decision regarding their pregnancy.

schemes.title: Baby Bonus Cash Gift
schemes.description: Help parents defray child-raising costs through regular cash payouts in their child's early years.

schemes.title: Baby Support Grant
schemes.description: Help parents ease financial concerns about raising a child during extraordinary times.

schemes.title: Car Park Label Scheme
schemes.description: Provides two types of labels that allow drivers (Class 1) and passengers (Class 2) with medically certified mobility challenges to park at accessible spaces, so they can board or alight from their vehicles safely.

schemes.title: CAREbuddy
schemes.description:
CAREbuddy is a supportive service for caregivers, provided by trained volunteers (CAREbuddy) who are also caregivers to dependents with disabilities.

CAREbuddy programme is 6-months long during which the CAREbuddy provides emotional support, shares resources, and helps caregivers progress in their caregiving journey.

schemes.title: CAREconnect
schemes.description: CAREconnect offers inclusive social events for family bonding and connection to fellow caregivers and volunteers, through mobilising support groups, organising inclusive, social, and/or respite events, and webinars.

schemes.title: Caregiver Training and Support Programme
schemes.description: Provides training and support to caregivers of persons with mental health conditions so that they can better cope with their caregiving duties.

schemes.title: Caregivers Training Grant (CTG)
schemes.description: Subsidy for caregivers to offset the training fees of approved courses to equip themselves with the necessary skills to care for their loved ones.

schemes.title: CARENIGHTS
schemes.description: Supports children aged 6 to 14 from vulnerable families with structured evening care services.

schemes.title: CareShield Life
schemes.description: Provides basic financial protection for Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents with severe disability, especially during old age and need long-term care.

schemes.title: CareShield Life / ElderShield Supplements
schemes.description: Provides additional benefits, like higher payouts, for CareShield Life or ElderShield policyholders.

schemes.title: CareShield Life Premium Subsidies
schemes.description: To ensure that CareShield Life premiums are affordable, the Government has committed to providing several premium support measures, such as Premium Subsidies, Participation Incentives and Additional Participation Incentives for Merdeka and Pioneer Generation.

schemes.title: CAREwell
schemes.description: CAREwell is a program that supports caregivers in their caregiving role, emotional and mental wellness, decision- making regarding services, and care management.

schemes.title: Cash Relief for Platform Workers and Taxi Drivers
schemes.description: $200 cash payout for eligible platform workers and taxi drivers.

schemes.title: Centre-based Nursing
schemes.description: Basic nursing care for seniors at a centre near their homes.

schemes.title: Change in HDB Flat Ownership After Flat Owner's Demise
schemes.description: Retain your HDB flat following the demise of joint owner or sole owner/tenant-in-common.

schemes.title: Child Development Account
schemes.description: Special savings account for the child, which can be used for approved areas of child-raising expenditure, including healthcare and preschool fees.

schemes.title: Child LifeSG Credits
schemes.description: Provides broad-based support for Singaporean families with children.

schemes.title: Child Protection Specialist Centre (CPSC)
schemes.description: Serves as specialists on child protection matters to provide community-based support to children who face abuse or neglect at home.

schemes.title: ComCare Assistance
schemes.description: Provides financial support for individuals and families facing varied challenges, ensuring timely aid for both short-term and long-term needs.

schemes.title: ComLink+
schemes.description: Empower lower-income families to achieve stability, self-reliance, and social mobility.

schemes.title: Community Development Council (CDC) Vouchers
schemes.description: Can be used at participating heartland merchants, hawkers, and supermarkets

schemes.title: Community Health Assist Scheme (CHAS)
schemes.description: Provides subsidies for medical and dental care at participating GPs and dental clinics for all Singapore Citizens.

schemes.title: Community Mental Health Services
schemes.description: Community mental health teams located across Singapore provide support and access to mental health care for those in need.

schemes.title: Community Outreach Teams (CREST)
schemes.description: Listens to your concerns and provides support such as therapy, as your in-person First Stop for Mental Health.

schemes.title: Community Rehabilitation Centre
schemes.description: Centre-based therapy sessions to help seniors improve mobility, speech, and daily living skills.

schemes.title: Counselling
schemes.description: Provides counselling and psychotherapy to individuals, couples and families facing interpersonal, intrapersonal, and mental health issues.

schemes.title: Counselling (Seniors)
schemes.description: Provides counselling to older persons aged 50 and above and/or their caregivers, to improve their mental well-being and resilience to cope with life’s challenges.

schemes.title: CPF Education Loan Scheme
schemes.description: A loan scheme that allows CPF member to use their Ordinary Account (OA) savings to pay for their own, children’s, spouse’s, siblings' or relatives' government subsidised tuition fees for full-time diploma/degree courses at Approved Educational Institutions (AEIs).

schemes.title: CPF Housing Grant
schemes.description: Provide more support for first-time homebuyers to purchase resale HDB flats.

schemes.title: CPF Housing Grant (Families) - Top-Up Grant
schemes.description: Provides up to $40,000 housing grants to eligible families if they had previously received CPF Housing Grant for Singles and now qualify for the CPF Housing Grant for Families.

schemes.title: CPF Housing Grant for Executive Condominiums (ECs)
schemes.description: Provides up to $30,000 subsidy for eligible first-timer applicants buying an Executive Condominium (EC).

schemes.title: CPF Housing Scheme
schemes.description: Enables CPF members to use their Ordinary Account (OA) savings to buy properties and pay for various housing purchase-related costs if they are owners of the property.

schemes.title: CPF Investment Scheme (CPFIS)
schemes.description: Provides CPF members an option to invest their OA and SA savings to enhance retirement funds.

schemes.title: CPF LIFE
schemes.description: CPF Lifelong Income For the Elderly (CPF LIFE) is a national longevity insurance annuity scheme that provides you with monthly payouts no matter how long you live.

schemes.title: CPF Nomination
schemes.description: Allows you to decide what happens to your CPF savings after your death.

schemes.title: Day Activity Centre (DAC)
schemes.description: Community-based facilities that provide care and skills training to persons with disabilities aged 18 and above to maximise their independence.

schemes.title: Day Hospice Care
schemes.description: A safe and supportive environment during the day for patients with life-limiting illnesses and their caregivers.

schemes.title: Dementia Day Care
schemes.description: Mind stimulating activities, exercises and personal care at day care centres for seniors with dementia.

schemes.title: Dependant's Protection Scheme (DPS)
schemes.description: Term life insurance scheme, solely administered by Great Eastern Life that provides basic financial protection for you and your family in the event of death, terminal illness or total permanent disability.

schemes.title: Deputyship
schemes.description: For persons who lack mental capacity and have not made a Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA) and/or have no donee to make certain decisions on their behalf.

schemes.title: DigitalAccess@Home
schemes.description: Provides subsidised broadband and laptops/tablets to lower-income households to support their lifestyle needs, including work and social activities.

schemes.title: Disabled Persons Scheme (DPS)
schemes.description: Eligible drivers are exempted from paying the premium for the Certificate of Entitlement (COE) and the Additional Registration Fee (ARF) when they purchase a vehicle.

schemes.title: Early Intervention Programme for Infants & Children (EIPIC)
schemes.description: EIPIC is a centre-based programme that provides therapy and educational intervention for children aged 0-6 years who require medium to high levels of early intervention (EI) support.

schemes.title: Early Intervention Programme for Infants and Children - P (EIPIC-P)
schemes.description: EIPIC-P is a programme that provides therapy and educational intervention for children aged 0 to below 7 years who require medium to high levels of early intervention (EI) support.

schemes.title: Earned Income Relief
schemes.description: Provides tax relief for individuals who are gainfully employed or carrying on a trade, business, profession or vocation.

schemes.title: Edusave Account
schemes.description: Provides $230 to $290 annually for approved fees and programmes for every Singapore Citizen child, aged 7 to 16 or studying in a primary or secondary school. Ad-hoc top-ups may be made by the Government to the child’s Edusave account periodically.

schemes.title: ElderFund
schemes.description: Discretionary government assistance scheme to support care needs of lower-income Singapore Citizens with severe disability.

schemes.title: ElderShield
schemes.description: Provides basic financial support to Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents with severe disability, especially during old age and need long-term care.

schemes.title: Eligible Schemes Enrolment (ESE)
schemes.description: A streamlined process to apply for several long-term care financial support schemes administered by the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) at the same time.

schemes.title: Enabled Living Programme (ELP)
schemes.description: A community living programme that empowers adults with disabilities to live independently in the community for as long as possible

schemes.title: Enabling Business Hub
schemes.description: Developed by SG Enable, Enabling Business Hubs (EBHs) bring training and employment opportunities closer to homes for persons with disabilities through customised job support and inclusive workplace practices.

schemes.title: Enabling Transport Subsidy (ETS)
schemes.description: Supports eligible Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents with disabilities who need to use dedicated transport provided by the Social Service Agencies (SSAs) to access the Early Intervention Programme for Infants and Children (EIPIC), Special Education (SPED) schools, Day Activity Centres (DACs), Sheltered Workshops (SWs), Special Student Care Centres (SSCCs), Enabling Skills for Life Programme (ESLP), Enabling Business Hubs (EBHs) and Enabling Service Hubs (ESHs).

schemes.title: Enhanced Budget 2026 Cost-of-Living Special Payment
schemes.description: $400 to $600 cash payout for eligible Singaporean adults.

schemes.title: Enhanced Climate Friendly Households Programme (Climate Vouchers)
schemes.description: Encourage households to be more efficient in their energy and water consumption by helping to defray the upfront cost of adopting such energy and water-efficient appliances.

schemes.title: Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (Families)
schemes.description: Provides up to $120,000 for eligible first-time applicants applying as a family to assist with new or resale flat purchases.

schemes.title: Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (Singles)
schemes.description: Provides up to $60,000 in Enhanced CPF Housing Grants (EHG) (Singles) for eligible first-timer applicants buying a new or resale flat on their own, or with their non-resident spouses.

schemes.title: Enhanced Home Personal Care (HPC+)
schemes.description: Support frail or homebound seniors who require assistance with activities of daily living, and/or general support with routine tasks in the community.

schemes.title: Enhancement for Active Seniors (EASE)
schemes.description: Subsidy for Singapore Citizen households with at least one senior who meets age criterion and needs help to install senior-friendly fittings.

schemes.title: Enhancement for Active Seniors (Private Housing): EASE (Private)
schemes.description: Provides subsidies to Singapore Citizen seniors living in private properties, for the installation of senior-friendly fittings.

schemes.title: Equipment Rental Scheme (ERS)
schemes.description: Subsidises the rental of essential care equipment for patients with serious illnesses.

schemes.title: Executive Condominiums (ECs)
schemes.description: Provides a more affordable option to eligible Singaporean households who aspire to own private housing.

schemes.title: Experiential Learning and Mentoring Programme (ELMP)
schemes.description: Supports youths through mentoring and, experiential learning. It provides youths with a safe and conducive place to hang out after school and empowers them with pro-social skills and resilience.

schemes.title: Family and Parenthood Priority Scheme (FPPS)
schemes.description: Up to 60% of Sale of Balance Flats (SBF) and up to 40% of Build-To-Order (BTO) flats are made available for eligible first-timer buyers.

schemes.title: Family Care Scheme (FCS) (Joint Balloting)
schemes.description: Helps parents and their child(ren), married or single, to jointly apply for 2 units in the same Build-To-Order (BTO) project.

schemes.title: Family Care Scheme (FCS) (Proximity)
schemes.description: Helps parents and their child(ren), married or single, to live with or near each other for mutual care and support.

schemes.title: Family Service Centre (FSC)
schemes.description: FSCs provide support for vulnerable individuals and families with social and emotional issues, and work towards stability, self-reliance and social mobility.

schemes.title: Fostering Scheme
schemes.description: Provides a safe and nurturing family environment for children needing care and protection, offering love, stability, and essentials like food and shelter. Foster families create positive family experiences, demonstrating care and concern, with the aim to reunite children with their birth families once safe to do so.

schemes.title: Fresh Start Housing Scheme
schemes.description: Helps families with children who are currently living in public rental flats to own a 2-room Flexi flat or 3-room flat on a shorter lease.

schemes.title: Gift Of A Lifetime Plus (GOAL+)
schemes.description: Gift Of A Lifetime Plus (GOAL+) aims to provide eligible caregivers of person with disability (PWDs) with an initial capital of $5,000 to set up trust accounts with Special Needs Trust Company Pte Ltd (SNTC). Under GOAL+, the Government sponsors matching donations of up to $10,000 for low- and middle-income families who contribute to the trust account within a five-year window period.

schemes.title: Government Bursaries for Higher Education
schemes.description: Provides financial assistance for Singapore Citizen students from lower- and middle-income families studying in MOE-subsidised full-time and part-time Nitec, Higher Nitec, diploma and undergraduate courses at publicly funded post-secondary education institutions.

schemes.title: Government-Paid Adoption Benefit (GPAB)
schemes.description: Provides up to 12 weeks of Government-paid income for eligible adoptive working mothers who do not qualify for Adoption Leave for Mothers (AL).

schemes.title: Government-Paid Childcare Leave (GPCL) and Extended Childcare Leave (ECL)
schemes.description: Provides up to 6 days of leave for eligible working parents and legal guardians with children below 7 years old, and 2 days for those with children aged 7 to 12.

schemes.title: Government-Paid Maternity Benefit (GPMB)
schemes.description: Provides up to 16 weeks of income support for eligible working mothers who do not qualify for Government-Paid Maternity Leave.

schemes.title: Government-Paid Maternity Leave (GPML)
schemes.description: Provides up to 16 weeks of paid leave for eligible working mothers to care for their newborns.

schemes.title: Government-Paid Paternity Benefit (GPPB)
schemes.description: Provides up to 4 weeks of income support, for eligible working fathers who do not qualify for Government-Paid Paternity Leave (GPPL).

schemes.title: Government-Paid Paternity Leave (GPPL)
schemes.description: Provides up to 4 weeks of Government-Paid Paternity Leave (GPPL), for eligible working fathers.

schemes.title: GRaduate Industry Traineeships (GRIT)
schemes.description: Equips fresh graduates with experience and skills, easing their transition into full-time employment.

schemes.title: GRaduate Industry Traineeships @Gov (GRIT@Gov)
schemes.description: Equips fresh graduates with experience and skills, easing their transition into full-time employment.

schemes.title: Grandparent Caregiver Relief (GCR)
schemes.description: Provides tax relief of up to $3,000 to working mothers who engage their parents, grandparents, parents-in-law or grandparents-in-law as caregivers for their children.

schemes.title: grovve
schemes.description: An integrated, youth-centric wellness centre offering a safe space where young people aged 12 to 25 can seek mental health support.

schemes.title: GST Voucher (GSTV) – Cash
schemes.description: Enhanced cash payouts up to $850 from 2024, to help lower-income Singaporeans, residing in Singapore, with their daily living expenses.

schemes.title: GST Voucher (GSTV) – MediSave
schemes.description: MediSave top-up of up to $450 for Singapore Citizens aged 65 and above, residing in Singapore.

schemes.title: Halogen SPARK!
schemes.description: A structured evidence-based entrepreneurship curriculum that targets Secondary 3 students who are from the G1/G2 Subject Based Banding (SBB) Stream that improves better school-focused outcomes, including their attendance and academic performance.

schemes.title: HCSA SPIN
schemes.description: SPIN supports single parents and lone caregivers through casework and counselling, social support network such as befriending, practical support and an online portal of information and resources.

schemes.title: Healthier SG
schemes.description: A national strategy focused on preventive care to empower individuals to take steps toward better health, with the support of their Healthier SG clinic and community partners.

schemes.title: Healthy 365
schemes.description: Healthy 365 is a mobile application that helps resident to discover and access healthy lifestyle offerings that will help them to achieve their health goals.

schemes.title: Healthy with KIDSTART
schemes.description: Support lower income families with Singapore Citizen children aged up to 6 years old with fresh produce packs.

schemes.title: Home Caregiving Grant (HCG)
schemes.description: Provides financial support to help with caregiving expenses for households caring for persons with moderate to severe disabilities.

schemes.title: Home Medical
schemes.description: Check-ups, prescriptions and consultations by a doctor for seniors who are not able to leave their homes.

schemes.title: Home Nursing
schemes.description: Nursing services provided at home for seniors who are unable to leave their homes.

schemes.title: Home Palliative Care
schemes.description: Support caregivers in caring for patients with life-limiting illnesses at home.

schemes.title: Home Personal Care (HPC)
schemes.description: Supports frail or homebound seniors who require help with activities of daily living and/or housekeeping.

schemes.title: Home Protection Scheme (HPS)
schemes.description: Mortgage-reducing insurance that protects you and your loved ones from losing your Housing and Development Board (HDB) flat in the event of death, terminal illness, or total permanent disability.

schemes.title: Home Therapy
schemes.description: Therapy sessions at home to help seniors regain their ability to carry out daily activities.

schemes.title: Hospital-to-Work Transition Programme
schemes.description: Provides case management, rehabilitation and employment support for persons with acquired disability from accidents or medical conditions who are looking to return to work.

schemes.title: Housing Loan from Financial Institutions (FI)
schemes.description: Supports your flat purchase through housing loans from Financial Institutions (FI) regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore.

schemes.title: Housing Loan from HDB
schemes.description: Provides eligible buyers with financing via housing loan to purchase or take over ownership of a HDB flat.

schemes.title: Housing Subsidy - Citizen Top-Up
schemes.description: Provides a $10,000 housing subsidy for eligible Singapore Citizen/ Permanent Resident households when a family member becomes a Singapore Citizen.

schemes.title: IHL Internship Programme
schemes.description: The SG Enable IHL Internship Programme matches students with disabilities to internships offered by inclusive organisations in various sectors based on their course of study, interests and preferences. Students will learn in a real work environment, build up their professional networks, and gain practical job-related knowledge and skills.

schemes.title: Infant and Childcare Subsidies
schemes.description: Provides tiered subsidies to help cover infant care and childcare fees for Singapore Citizen children from different income backgrounds.

schemes.title: Inpatient Hospice Palliative Care Service (IHPCS)
schemes.description: Supports end-of-life patients who cannot be cared for at home and require inpatient care.

schemes.title: Integrated Shield Plan (IP)
schemes.description: A private medical insurance plan, offered by private insurers, that provides optional additional coverage on top of what you are already covered for under MediShield Life.

schemes.title: Interim Disability Assistance Scheme for the Elderly (IDAPE)
schemes.description: Provides monthly cash payout for elderly Singapore Citizens with severe disabilities who are not eligible for ElderShield.

schemes.title: ITE Monthly Financial Assistance Scheme (MFAS)
schemes.description: Provides a monthly allowance to full-time Singaporean students from lower-income households who need regular financial assistance for daily expenses.

schemes.title: ITE Special Student Assistance Scheme (SSAS)
schemes.description: One-off financial assistance to help students tide over short-term financial difficulties.

schemes.title: Job Placement and Job Support
schemes.description: Provides persons with disabilities employment assistance through job matching and job coaching for up to 12 months.

schemes.title: KidSTART
schemes.description: Supports pregnant mothers and lower-income families in early childhood development, to build strong foundations for children aged 6 and below.

schemes.title: Kindergarten Fee Assistance Scheme (KiFAS) and KiFAS Startup Grant (SUG)
schemes.description: Provides subsidies for kindergarten programmes to ensure affordability for low and middle-income Singapore Citizen families, along with an annual KiFAS Start-Up Grant (SUG) to assist low-income families with initial costs.

schemes.title: Large Families Scheme
schemes.description: Provides more support for Singaporean families who have three or more children.

schemes.title: Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA)
schemes.description: A legal document that allows you (the 'Donor') to appoint one or more trusted persons (the 'Donee') to  make decisions on your behalf in the event you lose mental capacity.

schemes.title: Lease Buyback Scheme
schemes.description: Provides seniors with a steady stream of retirement income when they sell the tail-end of their flat lease to HDB while they continue to occupy the flat for the lease they retained.

schemes.title: Legal Aid Bureau
schemes.description: Provides legal help for eligible individuals in various civil proceedings.

schemes.title: Life Insurance Relief
schemes.description: Provides tax relief of up to $5,000 for individuals who paid annual insurance premiums on their own life insurance policies.

schemes.title: Life! Mentors
schemes.description: A 5-8 year mentoring programme that supports children (6-13 years old) a fair chance to succeed in life.

schemes.title: Live On!
schemes.description: Year-long, family-centric psychological intervention for youths with high suicide risk as they transit from hospitalisation into the community.

schemes.title: Live Well, Age Well Programme
schemes.description: The Live Well, Age Well programme is co-organised by HPB and PA to provide holistic activities to improve the physical, mental and social health of adults aged 50 and above.

schemes.title: Lively Places Fund
schemes.description: Provides funding of up to $20,000 for community-driven projects that enhance public spaces and foster community bonds.

schemes.title: Long-Term Care Subsidies
schemes.description: Provides means-tested subsidies for long-term care services by MOH-funded long-term care providers.

schemes.title: Maintenance Day Care Centre
schemes.description: Full day programme of engaging activities, exercises and personal care for seniors at day care centres.

schemes.title: Maintenance Support Central (MSC)
schemes.description: Provides support and assistance for clients who have difficulty in receiving spousal and/or child maintenance.

schemes.title: Majulah Package – Earn and Save Bonus
schemes.description: Supplements eligible working seniors' retirement savings through an annual Earn and Save Bonus credited to their CPF account.

schemes.title: Majulah Package – MediSave Bonus
schemes.description: Supplements medical savings of seniors through one-off CPF bonus.

schemes.title: Majulah Package – Retirement Savings Bonus
schemes.description: One-off bonus for seniors with CPF retirement savings below the 2023 Basic Retirement Sum.

schemes.title: Marriage Preparation Programme for Minor and Young Muslim Couples
schemes.description: Provides pre- and post-marriage support for minor and young couples.

schemes.title: Matched MediSave Scheme
schemes.description: Helps eligible Singapore Citizens to strengthen MediSave adequacy by matching cash top-ups made to their MediSave Accounts (MA).

schemes.title: Matched Retirement Savings Scheme
schemes.description: Helps eligible Singaporeans with lower retirement savings to save more by matching cash top-ups made to their Retirement or Special Accounts (RA/SA). This will boost their monthly payouts in retirement.

schemes.title: Meals on Wheels (MOW)
schemes.description: Meal deliveries for homebound clients who are unable to buy and prepare their own meals and do not have a caregiver to help them to do so.

schemes.title: Medical Escort and Transport (MET)
schemes.description: For seniors who need help going for medical appointments.

schemes.title: Medical Fee Exemption Card (MFEC)
schemes.description: Subsidised standard medical treatment for needy residents at approved stay-in care institutions.

schemes.title: MediFund
schemes.description: For Singaporeans who face difficulties with remaining medical bills after receiving government subsidies and other means of payment.

schemes.title: MediSave
schemes.description: A personal healthcare savings account that helps you pay for you and loved ones' healthcare expenses over your lifetime, especially when you retire and no longer have regular income.

schemes.title: MediSave Care
schemes.description: Allows Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents with severe disability to make monthly cash withdrawals from their and/or their spouse’s MediSave Account for long-term care.

schemes.title: MediSave for Assisted Conception Procedures
schemes.description: Allows eligible couples to withdraw up to $15,000 per patient from MediSave to pay for Assisted Conception Procedures (ACP) that aid them in conceiving.

schemes.title: MediSave Grant for Newborns (MGN)
schemes.description: All Singapore Citizen newborns are eligible for the MediSave Grant for Newborns (MGN) of up to $5,000.

schemes.title: MediSave Maternity Package
schemes.description: Enables applicants to claim up to $3,670 for pre-delivery medical expenses and baby delivery expenses from MediSave.

schemes.title: MediShield Life
schemes.description: A basic health insurance plan managed by the CPF Board to help pay for large hospital bills and selected outpatient treatments.

schemes.title: MediShield Life Premium Subsidies
schemes.description: To keep MediShield Life premiums affordable, the Government provides several premium support measures, such as Premium Subsidies, Pioneer Generation Subsidies and Merdeka Generation Subsidies.

schemes.title: Merdeka Generation Package
schemes.description: Supporting Merdeka Generation seniors in their silver years by helping them to stay active, healthy and providing peace of mind over future healthcare costs.

schemes.title: Mid-Career Pathways Programme (MCPP)
schemes.description: A full-time attachment programme for mature, mid-career individuals seeking a career switch. Applicants are attached to a host organisation for 4-6 months to gain industry-relevant skills and experience.

schemes.title: MightyKids, Families & Community (MightyKFC)
schemes.description: MightyKFC is a developmental mentoring programme that aims to nurture at-risk children and youth in the Telok Blangah region.

schemes.title: Migrant Domestic Worker Levy Concession
schemes.description: Provides concessionary levy at $60 per month if there is an eligible person residing in the household.

schemes.title: Mobile Access for Seniors (MAS)
schemes.description: Provides subsidised smartphone and mobile plans to lower-income seniors who want to go digital but cannot afford them.

schemes.title: MOE Financial Assistance Scheme (MOE FAS)
schemes.description: Provides financial assistance to lower-income families with children who are in Government and Government-Aided Schools and Specialised Schools.

schemes.title: MOE Higher Education Student Loan (HESL) Scheme
schemes.description: Loan scheme to help students who are taking MOE-subsidised diploma, undergraduate or postgraduate programmes in publicly-funded post-secondary education institutions to finance their tuition fees and borrow a living allowance loan for other education-related expenses. It also helps undergraduates to finance cost of institution-approved overseas student programme.

schemes.title: MOE Independent School Bursary (ISB)
schemes.description: Provides financial assistance to lower- and middle-income families with children who are in Independent Schools and some Specialised Independent Schools.

schemes.title: MUIS Zakat Financial Assistance
schemes.description: Provides monthly financial assistance and support in other forms to eligible low-income Muslim households.

schemes.title: My Legacy
schemes.description: Plan, store and share your legal, healthcare and estate matters securely with people you trust.

schemes.title: National Service LifeSG Credits
schemes.description: $200 in LifeSG credits for all eligible past and present national servicemen to recognise their contributions to Singapore’s defence and security.

schemes.title: National Silver Academy
schemes.description: Offers learning opportunities, short-term courses and programmes for seniors.

schemes.title: NSman Relief
schemes.description: Provides tax relief to eligible operationally ready National Servicemen (NSmen) to recognise their contributions to National Service, as well as to the wives and parents of NSmen to recognise the support they give to their husbands or sons.

schemes.title: Nursing Home
schemes.description: A long-term residential care facility for seniors who have limited or no caregiver support and require assistance with daily nursing and living needs.

schemes.title: Nursing Home Respite Care
schemes.description: Short-term residential care option to provide respite for caregivers of seniors with high care needs.

schemes.title: OnePA CC Courses
schemes.description: Provide opportunities for residents to pick up new skills and interests through courses offered at Community Centres/Clubs (CCs) and Residents’ Networks (RNs).

schemes.title: Our Lives Our Voices (OLOV)
schemes.description: OLOV aims to empower clients to become self-advocates and foster an inclusive society where PWIDs can independently participate in the community in a meaningful manner. Through personalised training and peer support, it builds confidence and independence.

schemes.title: PA Community Programmes and Events
schemes.description: Provides one-stop access to a diverse range of community programmes and events organised by the People's Association.

schemes.title: Parent Relief/Parent Relief (Disability)
schemes.description: Provides tax relief of up to $14,000 per dependant, to recognise individuals supporting their parents, grandparents, parents-in-law or grandparents-in-law in Singapore.

schemes.title: Parenthood Provisional Housing Scheme (PPHS)
schemes.description: Provides temporary housing for families as they await the completion of their new flats.

schemes.title: Parenthood Tax Rebate (PTR)
schemes.description: Provides a one-off tax rebate of up to $20,000 per child to eligible parents to encourage them to have more children.

schemes.title: PAssion Card
schemes.description: A membership programme that allows its members to enjoy great discounts on courses and activities available at all Community Clubs and other PA outlets such as PAssion Wave. Members can also enjoy exclusive discounts at more than 2,000 participating PAssion Merchant outlets.

schemes.title: Persons with Disabilities Concession Card (PWDCC)
schemes.description: Provides persons with disabilities with concessionary rates for travel on public transport.

schemes.title: Pioneer Generation Disability Assistance Scheme (PioneerDAS)
schemes.description: Provides Pioneers with moderate or severe functional disabilities with cash assistance for everyday expenses.

schemes.title: Pioneer Generation Package
schemes.description: Special recognition to our Pioneer Generation through a package that assures them of affordable healthcare.

schemes.title: Platform Workers CPF Transition Support (PCTS)
schemes.description: From 2025 to 2028, the Platform Workers CPF Transition Support (PCTS) scheme provides monthly cash payments to support eligible lower-income platform workers who make increased CPF Ordinary and Special/Retirement Account contributions.

schemes.title: Post-Secondary Education Account (PSEA)
schemes.description: Provides educational financial support for eligible Singapore Citizens' post-secondary education.

schemes.title: Priority Scheme - First-Timer (Parents & Married Couples), FT(PMC) Category
schemes.description: To help young families settle down more quickly, additional support will be provided for applicants who qualify for the FT(PMC) category.

schemes.title: Professional Deputies and Donees Scheme
schemes.description: The scheme serves individuals who may not have suitable family members or friends to appoint as their proxy decision makers. Professionals may be appointed as proxy decision makers for these individuals for remuneration.

schemes.title: Protection Specialist Centre (PSC)
schemes.description: Provides services for individuals and families experiencing family violence, intimate partner violence or sexual violence.

schemes.title: Proximity Housing Grant (Families)
schemes.description: Provides up to $30,000 for families buying a resale flat to live with or near parents or children.

schemes.title: Proximity Housing Grant (Singles)
schemes.description: Provides up to $15,000 for eligible singles buying a resale flat to live with, or near, their parents or children.

schemes.title: Public Rental Scheme - Family Scheme
schemes.description: Provides heavily subsidised rental flats for Singaporean households with no other housing options and no family support.

schemes.title: Qualifying Child Relief (QCR)/Child Relief (Disability)
schemes.description: Provides tax relief to parents to recognise their efforts in supporting their children.

schemes.title: Remarriage Preparation Programme for Muslim Couples
schemes.description: Provides pre- and post-marriage support for remarrying couples.

schemes.title: Retirement Sum Topping-Up Scheme
schemes.description: Boost your own or loved ones’ retirement savings and payouts through voluntary cash top-ups or CPF transfer to your own or loved ones' Special Account (SA) or Retirement Account (RA).

schemes.title: Safe Place
schemes.description: Programme aims to empower women and their families with unsupported pregnancies to make informed and life-giving choices.

schemes.title: SAMH Youthreach
schemes.description: Provides psychosocial support and recovery programmes for youths aged 13 to 21 with emotional, psychological and psychiatric issues in the community.

schemes.title: Seniors' Mobility and Enabling Fund
schemes.description: Provides subsidies to seniors for mobility and assistive devices or home healthcare items.

schemes.title: Service and Conservancy Charges (S&CC) Rebate
schemes.description: Quarterly rebates to offset S&CC fees for HDB households. Eligible households will receive 1.5 to 3.5 months of the GST Voucher (GSTV) – S&CC Rebate.

schemes.title: Settling Outstanding Tax Matters and Bills for a Deceased Person
schemes.description: Enables executors or administrators to settle the deceased's taxes and outstanding debts using the estate's funds before distribution to beneficiaries.

schemes.title: Severe Disability Assessment (SDA)
schemes.description: Provides an assessment of your disability status conducted by a Ministry of Health (MOH)-accredited severe disability assessor.

schemes.title: SG Culture Pass
schemes.description: $100 credits to offset ticket purchases for eligible cultural offerings in support and celebration of local arts and heritage activities.

schemes.title: SG60 Vouchers
schemes.description: For all Singaporean adults in recognition of their contributions to the nation and to share the gains of Singapore's progress during SG60.

schemes.title: Shared Parental Leave  (SPL)
schemes.description: Support eligible working parents in sharing parental responsibility and caring for their infants.

schemes.title: Shared Parental Leave Benefit (SPB)
schemes.description: Support eligible working parents who do not qualify for the Shared Parental Leave (SPL) scheme due to their employment arrangements.

schemes.title: Shared Stay-in Senior Caregiving Services (Stay-in SCS)
schemes.description: Shared caregiving services for seniors living together in a shared residence.

schemes.title: Sheltered Workshops
schemes.description: Sheltered Workshops offer employment and/or vocational training to adults with disabilities who do not possess the competencies or skills for open employment.

schemes.title: Sibling Relief (Disability)
schemes.description: Provides tax relief to individuals supporting their siblings and siblings-in-law with disability.

schemes.title: Silver Housing Bonus (SHB)
schemes.description: Seniors aged 55 or above may receive cash bonus when they right-size to a 3-room or smaller HDB flat, and top-up the proceeds from the sale of their existing property into their CPF Retirement Account (RA) and join CPF LIFE.

schemes.title: Silver Support Scheme
schemes.description: Provides a quarterly cash supplement to give eligible seniors greater assurance in retirement.

schemes.title: SkillsFuture Credit
schemes.description: For Singapore Citizens aged 25 and above to pay for or offset the out-of-pocket course fees of approved courses.

schemes.title: SkillsFuture Credit (Mid-Career)
schemes.description: For Singapore Citizens aged 40 and above to pay for or offset the out-of-pocket course fees for selected courses that are oriented towards meeting industry and employment needs.

schemes.title: SkillsFuture Fellowships
schemes.description: Awards a $10,000 monetary award to support skills mastery for eligible Singapore Citizens.

schemes.title: SkillsFuture Jobseeker Support Scheme
schemes.description: Provides temporary financial support of up to $6,000 over 6 months to involuntarily unemployed individuals, to support them in finding a job that makes better use of their skills and experiences.

schemes.title: SkillsFuture Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy
schemes.description: Provides up to 90% subsidy on course fees for Singapore Citizens aged 40 and above.

schemes.title: SkillsFuture Mid-Career Training Allowance
schemes.description: Supports both full-time and part-time long-form training for Singapore Citizens aged 40 and above to upskill and reskill. Individuals can decide which type of training best suits their needs.

schemes.title: SkillsFuture Work-Study Degree
schemes.description: Provides work-relevant skills through on-the-job training and classroom learning for students and working adults.

schemes.title: Sober Living Framework (SLF)
schemes.description: Provides crisis intervention, therapy support, and long-term aftercare for persons and families impacted by substance and/or behavioural addictions.

schemes.title: Special Education (SPED) School (Autism Spectrum Disorder with intellectual impairment)
schemes.description: Special Education (SPED) schools provide education for children and youth with disabilities who are of school-going age.

schemes.title: Special Education (SPED) School (Autism Spectrum Disorder with no intellectual impairment)
schemes.description: Special Education (SPED) schools provide education for children and youth with disabilities who are of school-going age.

schemes.title: Special Education (SPED) School (Mild Intellectual Disability)
schemes.description: Special Education (SPED) schools provide education for children and youth with disabilities who are of school-going age.

schemes.title: Special Education (SPED) School (Moderate to Severe Intellectual Disability)
schemes.description: Special Education (SPED) schools provide education for children and youth with disabilities who are of school-going age.

schemes.title: Special Education (SPED) School (Multiple Disabilities)
schemes.description: Special Education (SPED) schools provide education for children and youth with disabilities who are of school-going age.

schemes.title: Special Education (SPED) School (Sensory impairment)
schemes.description: Special Education (SPED) schools provide education for children and youth with disabilities who are of school-going age.

schemes.title: Special Needs Savings Scheme (SNSS)
schemes.description: Enables parents to set aside CPF savings for the long-term care of children with special needs.

schemes.title: Special Needs Trust
schemes.description:
Special Needs Trust Company (SNTC) is a not-for-profit trust company and a registered charity. As a fully owned subsidiary of SG Enable, SNTC provides affordable trust services to safeguard monies set aside by caregivers to fund the long-term care needs of their beneficiaries who are persons with disability. 

The Special Needs Trust (SNT) is a legal arrangement for SNTC to hold monies for persons with disability (PWD).

schemes.title: SPED Financial Assistance Scheme (FAS)
schemes.description: Provides financial assistance to lower-income families with children who are in MOE-funded Special Education Schools.

schemes.title: Spouse Relief/Spouse Relief (Disability)
schemes.description: Provides tax relief of up to $5,500 to both male and female taxpayers who have supported their spouses.

schemes.title: Staggered Downpayment Scheme
schemes.description: Eases home purchase by allowing eligible first-timer couples and right-sizing flat owners to pay downpayment in 2 parts.

schemes.title: Stamp Duty Remissions for Married and Divorced Couples
schemes.description: Provides various stamp duty remissions for eligible couples buying new residential property or transferring their current one(s) as part of matrimonial proceedings.

schemes.title: Stamp Duty Remissions for Transfer of HDB Flats within Family
schemes.description: Provides stamp duty remission for eligible transfers of HDB flats within families.

schemes.title: Step One
schemes.description: Programme that equips caregivers of young children up to 7 years old diagnosed with developmental delay / disability with knowledge and skills to support their loved ones and themselves.

schemes.title: Step-Up CPF Housing Grant (Families)
schemes.description: Provides a $15,000 Step-Up CPF Housing Grant to eligible second-timer applicants buying a new or resale flat.

schemes.title: Strengthening Elderly Parent-Adult Child Bonds Programme
schemes.description: A 3-year pilot initiative aimed at strengthening relationships between elderly parents and their adult children.

schemes.title: Strengthening Families Programme (FAM)
schemes.description: Provides divorce support and family counselling to all families.

schemes.title: Student Care Fee Assistance (SCFA)
schemes.description: Provides fee assistance for children from lower-income working families enrolled in Student Care Centres (SCCs) registered with MSF.

schemes.title: Supplementary Retirement Scheme (SRS)
schemes.description: Provides tax relief to encourage individuals to save for retirement, over and above their CPF savings. Investment returns are tax-free before withdrawal and only 50% of withdrawals are taxable at retirement.

schemes.title: Take-a-Break (TAB)
schemes.description:
Take-a-Break (TAB) is a respite care programme to provide caregivers temporary relief from their caregiving responsibilities. 

Based on their needs, caregivers may choose from a range of home-based respite care services and determine the frequency of service over a specific duration. 

Subsidies are available for eligible caregivers.

schemes.title: Tax Payment Support
schemes.description: Supports eligible individuals in their tax payments through various payment arrangements such as longer GIRO-based instalment plans.

schemes.title: Tax Reliefs
schemes.description: Provides tax reliefs to taxpayers who support family members in need, inclusive of dependants with disabilities.

schemes.title: Taxi Subsidy Scheme (TSS)
schemes.description: For persons with permanent disabilities who are medically certified as unable to take public transport and totally dependent on taxi for travel to school, work or SG Enable-supported training.

schemes.title: Tenants' Priority Scheme (TPS)
schemes.description: Allocates up to 10% of Flexi / Build-To-Order (BTO) / Sale of Balance (SBF) flats for eligible HDB rental flat tenants to help them purchase a home.

schemes.title: The Builders Project
schemes.description: Aims to increase social capital and social discipline, and accomplish positive outcomes in Primary 4-6 school children who have been assessed to have higher needs.

schemes.title: The GRIT Academy
schemes.description: Mentoring programme for youths-at-risk in Jurong.

schemes.title: Third Child Priority Scheme (TCPS)
schemes.description: Provides priority in flat allocation to eligible families with 3 or more children.

schemes.title: Top-up to Child Development Account (CDA)
schemes.description: One-off $400 top-up to Child Development Account (CDA) for Singapore Citizens aged 0 to 6 from September 2023.

schemes.title: Transitional Shelter (TS)
schemes.description: Provide temporary accommodation and social work intervention to homeless families who have exhausted all other means of accommodation.

schemes.title: U-Save
schemes.description: Quarterly rebates to offset HDB households’ utilities expenses. In FY2026, eligible households will receive up to $760 in U-Save rebates.

schemes.title: Unpaid Infant Care Leave (UICL)
schemes.description: Provides up to 12 days of unpaid leave for eligible parents with Singapore citizen children below 2 years old.

schemes.title: Voluntary Housing Refund
schemes.description: Allows you to return any CPF savings used for your home purchase to your CPF account while still owning your property. Doing so reduces the refund amount you would have to make and increases the cash proceeds you would get when you eventually sell or transfer your property. This also boosts your retirement savings as you can benefit from CPF interest rates.

schemes.title: WiShine
schemes.description: This programme seeks to support widows and their children who are in bereavement, especially in the widow’s initial adjustment to widowhood. It also supports widows who have relapsed into their grief and have difficulty coping with grief and have weak social support.

schemes.title: Withdrawal of CPF Savings for Immediate Needs from Age 55
schemes.description: CPF members can make withdrawals from their CPF savings starting from age 55.

schemes.title: Withdrawal of CPF Savings on Reduced Life Expectancy
schemes.description: Members with reduced life expectancy due to a medical condition, as certified by an accredited doctor (from public hospitals, polyclinics, or a specialist), may apply to withdraw some of their CPF savings. Severe medical conditions causing them to be permanently unfit for work or to lack mental capacity permanently can also be considered.

schemes.title: Workfare Income Supplement (WIS) Scheme
schemes.description: Supplements eligible workers' income and CPF savings through cash and CPF payments.

schemes.title: Workfare Skills Support (Level-Up)
schemes.description: Enhanced tier of Workfare Skills Support (WSS), supporting lower-wage Singaporean workers who go for long-form training.

schemes.title: Workfare Skills Support (WSS) (Basic)
schemes.description: Provides training allowance and cash incentives to encourage lower-wage Singaporean workers to upskill via training.

schemes.title: Workfare Transport Concession Scheme
schemes.description: Provides recipients of Workfare Income Supplement with concessionary rates for travel on public transport.

schemes.title: Working Mother's Child Relief (WMCR)
schemes.description: Provides tax relief for eligible working mothers, up to 25% of earned income per child. Encourages married women to stay in the workforce after having children, and rewards families with children who are Singapore Citizens.

schemes.title: Youth COP
schemes.description: Aims to foster positive development and strengthen protective factors, empowering youths as crime-prevention leaders to help their communities thrive, stay safe, and build resilience.

schemes.title: Youth Integrated Team (YIT)
schemes.description: Provides community-based mental health assessment, therapeutic intervention, case management for youths with mild mental health conditions while monitoring and checking in with the youth before, during and after intervention has been provided.
